flavorText.en: Spoken aboard the Malphas Contemptus and quickly hushed: "It was never so under the empress."
flavorText.zh-CN: 马尔法斯轻蔑号上曾有人说出却又很快消声的话：“在女帝的统治下从未这样。”

flavorText.en: There was life, and He spoke unto it; and it was silent, and lived no more.
flavorText.zh-CN: 曾有生命，祂对其有言；然其沉默不语，不复再生。

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“克洛塔的末日”突袭

flavorText.en: "Hesitation kills." —Emissary of the Nine
flavorText.zh-CN: “犹豫使人丧命。”——玖的使者

flavorText.en: "He bore it well." —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “他使得不错。”——领主沙克斯

sourceString.en: Source: Complete Crucible matches and earn rank-up packages from Lord Shaxx.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成熔炉竞技场比赛并从领主沙克斯处获得升级包。

flavorText.en: Any errand is a fool's errand if you don't think for yourself.
flavorText.zh-CN: 人不为己，天诛地灭。

flavorText.en: Don't let pride keep you from a good meal.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不要因为骄傲而拒绝美食。

flavorText.en: "Pain… Fear… Sacrifice… Feed the fiend." —Mykel, Leader of the Acolytes of Nezarec
flavorText.zh-CN: “痛苦…恐惧…牺牲…皆可滋养恶魔。”——麦克尔，奈扎雷克的仆从首领

flavorText.en: Never forget.
flavorText.zh-CN: 永远忘不了。

flavorText.en: "We knew it would not be easy." —Paladin Hallam Fen
flavorText.zh-CN: “我们早就知道不会轻松。”——圣骑士霍拉姆·凡

sourceString.en: Source: Complete activities in the Dreaming City.
sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：完成在幽梦之城中的活动。

flavorText.en: "Better alone than in unwanted company." —Jjenr, Husk
flavorText.zh-CN: “孤独，胜过不想要的陪伴。”——躯壳，杰恩尔

flavorText.en: I can show you how we were in our prime. You need only ask, o student mine.
flavorText.zh-CN: 我可以向你展现我们最辉煌的时刻。你只需问，哦，我的学生啊。

flavorText.en: "Osiris said that he started to pity the Red Legion, getting trapped in here for infinite eternities. I think they're getting exactly what they deserve." —Sagira
flavorText.zh-CN: “奥斯里斯说他开始为猩红军团感到抱歉了，被困在这无尽之中。而我觉得他们真的是活该。”——萨吉拉

flavorText.zh-CN: 我们有很多事可以讨论呢，哦，我的搜寻者啊。

flavorText.en: Absolutely not.
flavorText.zh-CN: 绝对不行。

flavorText.en: My bite will turn your sweet flesh to vile rot.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你的鲜肉会因为我的撕咬而变得腐烂恶臭。

flavorText.en: A lesson in the art of falling.
flavorText.zh-CN: 掉落艺术的经验。

flavorText.zh-CN: 刺穿现实之心。

flavorText.en: Untether expectation from reality.
flavorText.zh-CN: 将期望与现实脱钩。

flavorText.en: Lose yourself in the moment.
flavorText.zh-CN: 此刻迷失自我。

flavorText.zh-CN: “如果外表能杀人的话，这玩意甚至根本不需要你瞄准。”——班西-44

flavorText.zh-CN: 枪管内部刻着一个名字：“奥尔顿-1”

flavorText.en: You can't go back.
flavorText.zh-CN: 你回不去了。

flavorText.en: "Ammunition is the universal currency of the Sol system. The Cabal prefer to keep it that way." —Caiatl, Empress of the Cabal
flavorText.zh-CN: “弹药是太阳系的通用货币。卡巴尔希望以后也是如此。”——查厄托，卡巴尔女帝

flavorText.en: "Deity turned three eyes from me." —Ir Kithana, Preceptor
flavorText.zh-CN: “神有三眼，避不看我。”——训诫者，伊尔·基萨纳

flavorText.en: "If you hear it, remove your helmet and face the closest Corsair. They will know what must be done." —Queen Mara
flavorText.zh-CN: “如果你听到了那声音，就摘下你的头盔，然后面对离你最近的海盗军。他们知道该怎么办。”——玛拉女王

flavorText.en: Night's falling. Where are you?
flavorText.zh-CN: 夜幕降临，你在何方？

flavorText.en: "He is the closest thing I will ever have to a son."
flavorText.zh-CN: “他对我来说是最接近儿子的人。”

flavorText.en: …can't let the whole continent get frightened by a few piddling lights in the sky, so get busy…
flavorText.zh-CN: …总不能因为天上一点无谓的光亮就让整个大陆吓破了胆，得行动起来…

flavorText.en: …physicists, chemists, hell, we need surveyors and mapmakers, not to mention a room full of computers…
flavorText.zh-CN: …物理学家、化学家，妈呀，我们还需要测量员和地图绘制员，更别提一屋子的计算机了…

flavorText.en: Archival|Helios|4341| Dr. Saleh, attached see Dr. Bray's redactions along with guidelines on professionalism. A minor workplace injury is no excuse for personal attacks.
flavorText.zh-CN: 档案|赫利俄斯|4341| 萨利赫博士，请查收附件内布瑞博士的修订，以及职业操守准则。一点小工伤绝不应成为人身攻击的理由。

flavorText.en: "The Fallen describe Darkness as a gale. A force of nature, arising suddenly, from seemingly nowhere." —The Exo Stranger
flavorText.zh-CN: “堕落者认为暗影如同一阵强风。一种自然的力量，突然出现，源自无形之中。”——Exo陌客

flavorText.en: Can you follow the terminator to its end?
flavorText.zh-CN: 你能追随终结者到最后吗？

sourceString.zh-CN: 来源：“永恒沙漠”史诗突袭

flavorText.en: Mountains must be devoured one bite at a time.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一口吃不成胖子，一步到不了天边。

flavorText.zh-CN: 它在黄昏闪耀时，幸运必将降临于你。

flavorText.en: Grab and go.
flavorText.zh-CN: 拿起就走。

flavorText.en: Perception is a metaphysical construct.
flavorText.zh-CN: 感知是一种形而上学的构造。

flavorText.en: "You're on thin ice, Guardian. Good, I can't stand to see talent playing it safe!" —Lord Shaxx
flavorText.zh-CN: “守护者，你现在如履薄冰。很好，我最受不了有才干的人还那么小心翼翼！”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: If you think you're in charge, you're not.
flavorText.zh-CN: 若你以为一切尽在掌握，那恰好说明并非如此。

flavorText.en: "No stars overhead. Best not to look up." —Amanda Holliday
flavorText.zh-CN: “头顶上没有星星。最好不要抬头看。”——阿曼达·霍利迪

flavorText.zh-CN: 朋友就像旅途中的伴侣，只有相互扶持才能走到最后。

flavorText.zh-CN: “直击敌人心脏！瞄准要害准没错。”——领主沙克斯

flavorText.en: "Inflexibility is its own virtue." —Sloane
flavorText.zh-CN: “顽强不屈本身就是种美德。”——斯隆

flavorText.zh-CN: 枪管内部刻着一个名字：“阿娜斯塔西娅-1”

flavorText.en: In the height of summer.
flavorText.zh-CN: 仲夏时分。

flavorText.en: Our eyes squinted, our teeth clenched, our prayers answered.
flavorText.zh-CN: 眯起眼睛，咬紧牙关，默念祷告。

flavorText.en: Gore befalls those who do not respect the hart.
flavorText.zh-CN: 不尊重者，在劫难逃。

flavorText.en: "I should never have let it come to this. Now each arrow is a penance." —Lisbon-13, Hunter of the Kentarch 3
flavorText.zh-CN: “我就不应该让事情发展到如此地步。现在每一支箭都是一件苦差。”——第三百夫长猎人，里斯本-13

flavorText.en: "Go, child! Run! Don't look back! Don't—"
flavorText.zh-CN: “快跑，孩子！跑起来！别往后看！别——”

flavorText.en: Desire peace, prepare for war, endure the irony.
flavorText.zh-CN: 渴望和平，准备战争，并忍受其中的讽刺。

flavorText.zh-CN: “知道结局不等于想要结束。”——第三百夫长术士，雷卡纳

flavorText.en: Delivering the inevitable, one pull at a time.
flavorText.zh-CN: 一枪一命，无处可逃。
